pages.name: admin reconciliation

slowest.sql: select order_items.seller_id, orders.currency, SUM(order_items.seller_earning_minor) AS total from "order_items" inner join "orders" on "orders"."id" = "order_items"."order_id" where "orders"."status" in ($1, $2, $3, $4) group by "order_items"."seller_id", "orders"."currency"
select seller_id, currency, SUM(amount_minor) AS total from "seller_ledger_entries" where "type" in ($1, $2, $3) group by "seller_id", "currency"

select "order_items"."id", "order_items"."seller_id", "orders"."currency", "order_items"."seller_earning_minor", (order_items.unit_price_minor * order_items.quantity - order_items.discount_minor - order_items.refunded_minor) - ((order_items.unit_price_minor * order_items.quantity - order_items.discount_minor - order_items.refunded_minor) * order_items.commission_bps + 5000) / 10000 AS expected fro

statements: select order_items.seller_id, orders.currency, SUM(order_items.seller_earning_minor) AS total from "order_items" inner join "orders" on "orders"."id" = "order_i
select seller_id, currency, SUM(amount_minor) AS total from "seller_ledger_entries" where "type" in ($1, $2, $3) group by "seller_id", "currency"
select seller_id, currency, -SUM(amount_minor) AS total from "payouts" where "status" != $1 group by "seller_id", "currency"
select seller_id, currency, SUM(amount_minor) AS total from "seller_ledger_entries" where "type" in ($1, $2) group by "seller_id", "currency"
select count(*) as "aggregate" from "user_notifications" where "user_id" = $1 and "read_at" is null
